architecture_patterns.page_builder: Dynamic PageBuilder Block Architecture via Directus M2A
architecture_patterns.permissions: Public read enabled for vehicles, vehicle_trims, vehicle_colors, dealers, pages, globals (policy-based field whitelists)

active_sprint.current_task: Hybrid vehicle schema applied (vehicle_colors collection; vehicles.hero_block M2O + colors/highlights/trims O2M with list-o2m interfaces; vehicle_trims.key_features converted to list repeater of {value} strings; block_content_items.vehicle M2O). Outlander Sport seeded: hero block "Drive Your Ambition" with generated media, 3 paint colors, 3 highlight blocks, ES/SE FWD/SEL Premium FWD trims. Next: render /showroom/[slug].vue against the nested vehicles payload.

known_gotchas: NEVER run 'docker-compose down -v' — it deletes the persistent Postgres volume.
ADMIN_TOKEN is only used on first bootstrap; admin static token is set directly on the user row.

Directus 12.3 schema API: GET /schema/snapshot -> POST /schema/diff?mode=merge (body = target snapshot with version:2 + directus version + vendor) -> POST /schema/apply (body = { hash, diff } exactly as returned by /schema/diff). /schema/state and GET /schema/diff do not exist in 12.x.
vehicle_trims.key_features uses the list (repeater) interface over an array of {value} objects — legacy plain-string arrays were migrated in place; always write new trims in the {value} shape.

Public reads are policy-based field WHITELISTS (directus/seeds/seed-permissions.py keeps them in sync): vehicles exposes hero_block/colors/highlights/trims and vehicle_colors has its own read row; `fields=*` returns only whitelisted fields.

Public /assets/:id delivery requires a public read row on directus_files — added to FULL_READ in directus/seeds/seed-permissions.py (re-run it after seeding new media or re-cloning); without it hero/colour images 403 for anonymous visitors.

Directus items are GET-only, so a long `fields` list bloats the query string. Node's HTTP server rejects request lines >~16KB with HTTP 431 (empty body). The full page-builder deep-fetch is ~22KB and 431s — ALWAYS use the two-phase fetch in server/api/pages/one.get.ts (lean page query + per-collection batch enrichment) and keep any single items query well under ~15KB. A 431/500 from Directus here used to be masked as a 404 'Page not found'; the handler now rethrows real 404s and surfaces CMS failures as 500 'Failed to load page content'.

block_content_block.items and block_content_items.vehicle return in `sort` order automatically because their junction relations carry meta.sort_field = sort (no explicit deep _sort needed). block_layout_wrapper_sections has no sort_field — sections are insertion/PK order.

THIS Directus build is a 12.x HYBRID with core-collection item-read quirks (verified 2026-09-25): GET /items/directus_files and /items/directus_folders 403 for EVERY role including admin (system endpoints + POST /files + /folders + /assets all work fine). Consequences: file-existence checks must use a local state file (scripts/.seed-outlander-assets.json) or nested-relation expansion, never /items/directus_files; file metadata edits (e.g. setting `folder`) go through PATCH /files/:id — and the `folder` multipart field on POST /files is silently IGNORED, so always follow an upload with PATCH /files/:id {folder}.

M2M fields in this build expand to JUNCTION ROWS, not related items, and the replace-semantics are unreliable. Querying a highlight's image deep path must be `highlights.images.directus_files_id.*` (through the junction FK column) — `highlights.images.*` returns junction rows {id, block_content_items_id, directus_files_id} and a bare `highlights.*` returns `images` as junction ids (unusable). Writing M2M links: `images: [fileUuid]` 500s (uuid misread as the integer junction PK); send junction objects with explicit FKs (`images: [{ block_content_items_id, directus_files_id }]`) and manage the junction rows directly via /items/<junction> (GET/DELETE work) — stray rows with NULL FKs can survive a PATCH, so compare + clean before re-linking.

Public read on the M2M JUNCTION collection is required for the M2M field to appear in anonymous responses at all: block_content_items_files was missing from FULL_READ, which silently stripped `highlights.images` from public vehicle queries (Directus returns 200 with the field removed, not a 403). seed-permissions.py FULL_READ now includes it — re-run seed-permissions.py after any schema/permission change before trusting public deep-fetch results.

THIS build has NO working SEARCH endpoint: POST /items/:collection is plain CREATE — any POST body (including the {query:{...}} wrapper used by dealers.mjs / contact-form.mjs) creates a row with null fields instead of searching. Read via GET only; expect and clean up null orphans after any stray POST.

Query-string filters on this build are broken for strings: filter[field][_eq]="text" silently returns EMPTY and _in 400s; numeric _eq works. Never rely on string filters — read unfiltered (or numerically filtered) and match client-side.

The response cache on this build is unreliable for LIST reads: GET /items/:collection can return stale rows or an EMPTY array (even with cache-buster params) right after write bursts. Single-ITEM reads (/items/:collection/:id) and the vehicles.colors junction read have been consistently fresh — make every identity decision (dedupe, upsert, junction refresh) off single-item reads; treat an empty list on a known-non-empty collection as a stale-cache signature and refuse to create.

M2O fields are IGNORED in POST create payloads (e.g. vehicle_id arrives null on new vehicle_colors rows) — create the row, then PATCH /items/:collection/:id { <m2o_field> } and verify the link with a fresh single-item read.

Deleting a vehicle_colors row does NOT cascade to the vehicles.colors M2A junction (dangling ids survive and 403 on junction PATCH) — after any colour-row deletion, re-PATCH /items/vehicles/:id { colors: [survivingIds] } (verified ids only).

Directus 12.3 schema API: GET /schema/snapshot -> POST /schema/diff?mode=merge (partial snapshot with version:2) -> POST /schema/apply (diff body). /schema/state and GET /schema/diff do not exist in 12.x.
